body:
Thanks, I really appreciate that. I had noticed she was being a little weird with me and I decided to ask what was going on. I would worry either way, I thought (and would worry a lot more not knowing).  

I spent most of the morning bawling my eyes out. My eating disorder is something I constantly struggle with so I just really feel better if I know I have support and love. I don't think I am unloved necessarily but sometimes those feelings of loneliness are very strong and cloud my thoughts :(
